title: Multica-inspired Demand board management
decision: Borrow Multica's Demand/Attempt separation, triage, property editing, assignment boundaries, activity/execution logs and shared filtering model; keep AgentMux Demand filesystem truth, Core/ctxmux boundaries and zero/multiple Session semantics.
acceptance: Demand remains the Board primary entity and can exist with zero or multiple Sessions.
Board cards, fixed detail workspace, CUI and filesystem receipts share the same Demand fields and explicit status transitions.
Triage, assignment without start, explicit start, activity/execution history and destructive delete semantics are observable and testable.
The comparison names exact Multica reference files and exact AgentMux landing modules without copying vendor implementation or protocols.
PMO Teams has a stable JSON CLI for global observation, Demand control and explicit assignment/start/handoff actions.
P0/P1 are owned by this Feature; P2/P3 are recorded in a separate Feature and do not widen the active closure.
Plugin contributions are inspectable, versioned, reversible and evaluated from bounded execution evidence before activation.
